test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 43. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 15 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimal places) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume the **initial average** as the base: 43.

Net deviation for next 10 matches = 10 × (15 − 43) = −280.

Distribute deviation across all 33 matches = −280 ÷ 33 ≈ −8.4848.

New Average = 43 − 8.4848 = 34.5151 ≈ 34.52.

**∴ The correct answer is 34.52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs in first **23 matches** = 43

Average runs in next **10 matches** = 15

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (Total Runs) ÷ (Total Matches)

Total Runs = (n₁ × A₁) + (n₂ × A₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70a7b7d459173cf2e8ffb2671b1ab3f6416e90fe543f7aad5ba717343c15598d.png] 

⇒ Total runs in 23 matches = 23 × 43 = 989

⇒ Total runs in 10 matches = 10 × 15 = 150

⇒ Total runs in all 33 matches = 989 + 150 = 1139

⇒ Combined Average = 1139 ÷ 33

⇒ Combined Average = 34.515151...

⇒ Rounded to two decimal places = 34.52

**∴ The correct answer is 34.52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

When two groups with sizes n₁, n₂ and averages A₁, A₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Deviation Method

New Average = Old Average + (Total Deviation ÷ Total Number of Items). This is often faster for large numbers.

Rounding Decimals

To round to two decimal places, look at the third decimal; if it is 5 or more, round up the second decimal place.

**∴ The correct answer is 34.52.**</p
